verses.9: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.15: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.16: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.17: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
